elements.label: Chat panel (Let's prototype... conversation) enlarging from the full app view to a close-up
Key phrase 'serene mobile meditation' lifted off the baseline with a per-letter fade wave

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Sits inside a pitched descending glide that starts with the zoom; the same glide recurs in the score with no visual event (e007 around 32.3s and 32.6s), so it reads as music, not a dedicated whoosh.

pattern.description: The view jumps from the full Claude Design workspace into a tight close-up of the prompt in the chat panel, then the key phrase 'serene mobile meditation' lifts slightly above the line with a letter-by-letter fade wave to pull the eye to it.
pattern.why_premium: Two stages of focus: first the frame enlarges the one panel that matters, then a small typographic emphasis on three words in the prompt, so the viewer reads the brief without a highlighter box or callout.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.workspace', {scale: 1}, {scale: 2.8, transformOrigin: '20% 40%', duration: 0.15, ease: 'power3.out'}); then SplitText the phrase into chars and tl.to(chars, {y: -6, opacity: (i) => 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i / 3)), duration: 0.3, ease: 'sine.inOut', stagger: 0.02}, '+=0.05').
build_hint.remotion: Workspace scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 4], [1, 2.8], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); per char i of the phrase: y = -6 * spring({frame: frame - 6 - i * 0.5, fps, config: {damping: 20, stiffness: 200}}), opacity from a sine of i for the wave.

notes: camera.move is 'none' although scale sums to 1.348; the wide-to-close change between f734 and f736 happens within two frames and could be a near-cut rather than an animated zoom, so it is described as the panel scaling, not as a camera move. The phrase emphasis (baseline lift plus partial letter fade) is only visible in f742-f743; it could also be a deliberate frame artifact of a per-character wave.
